tests.name: unit suite (vitest)
tests.reason: Share buttons that did nothing now share. Staging is read-only and shares the production database, and a share opens the device share sheet, so the behaviour is pinned by vitest: useShareOrCopy.test.ts (native sheet, copy fallback, cancel, both failing) and the recurrence guard src/lib/__guards__/share-button.guard.test.ts (a Share button without a handler fails the build).
